summary: Describes the Internet Open Trading Protocol (IOTP) version 1.0, a framework meant to let different electronic commerce systems interoperate. It aims to give consumers, merchants and payment providers a common way to run purchases online. It is an informational memo.

eli5.summary: Shops and payment systems often speak different languages. This describes a common way for them to talk, so you can buy something online the same way no matter who is selling or handling the payment.
